title: Multiclass Linear Perceptrons with Multiplicative Margins
abstract: arXiv:2608.30028v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces a family of multiclass linear Perceptron classifiers with a multiplicative margin mechanism (MMPerc), as an alternative to standard margin-free and additive margin Perceptrons. The multiplicative formulation enforces classification confidence by requiring the true class score to exceed that of competing classes by a specified fraction of itself, rather than by a fixed additive threshold. This avoids dependence on score magnitudes arising from varied norms of data and class weight vectors. We propose several architectural and algorithmic variants of MMPerc, derive associated loss functions and mistake bounds for both linearly separable and non-separable data, and analyze key design considerations, including bias, margin threshold selection, and training modes. translated_title: 具有乘性间隔的多类线性感知机
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一类具有乘性间隔机制的多类线性感知机分类器（MMPerc），作为标准无间隔感知机和加性间隔感知机的替代方案。乘性形式通过要求真实类别的得分超过竞争类别得分自身的一定比例（而非固定的加性阈值）来强制保证分类置信度，从而避免了由于数据和类别权重向量范数不同而导致的对得分幅度的依赖。我们提出了MMPerc的若干结构和算法变体，推导了相应的损失函数，并针对线性可分和不可分数据给出了错误次数上界，同时分析了包括偏置、间隔阈值选择和训练模式在内的关键设计考量。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MMPerc分类器通常优于标准感知机以及经典基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种采用乘性间隔机制的多类线性感知机（MMPerc），通过要求真实类别得分以自身比例超过竞争类别得分来摆脱对得分幅度的依赖，为可分与不可分数据提供了理论错误上界，并在实验中通常优于标准感知机。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MMPerc, a family of multiclass linear Perceptrons with a multiplicative margin mechanism that requires the true class score to exceed competing scores by a fraction of itself, providing mistake bounds for both separable and non-separable data and typically outperforming the standard Perceptron.
